Blitzcrank.summary: A single hook can cost Milio the lane. Stay behind your minions at all times and hold Q so you can knock him back when he engages.

Thresh.summary: Thresh punishes sloppy positioning with picks, though your kit can stop his follow-up. Do not throw Q from predictable angles, and keep your defensive spells up whenever he looks for a hook.

Senna.summary: Her long range and steady poke make the lane uncomfortable. Do not let her land free Q trades, and lean on your healing to stay healthy.

Rakan.summary: He can dive you or your ADC fast with W and R. Hold Q and your ultimate to break up his engage chain.

Rell.summary: Rell has a strong engage and long CC chain. Save Q for her dive and avoid standing clumped with your ADC.

Brand.summary: His poke and area damage make lane tough. Focus on not getting tagged by his spells over and over.

Neeko.summary: She has strong engage and burst, especially when disguised. Keep your distance and watch for a Flash into ultimate.

Swain.summary: Swain applies constant pressure with area CC, and once he is in range he is hard to kite away from. Avoid letting him close the gap.

Pyke.summary: His hook, mobility and roams give constant kill threat. Q and R let you disengage, but an early catch can lose the lane, so play carefully in the first levels.

Camille.summary: Very dangerous if she reaches you, and her mobility makes your usual spacing unreliable. Respect her threat range at all times.

Leona.summary: Her engage is readable, so Q can interrupt her E and your ultimate can cleanse the follow-up CC. Positioning mistakes still get punished, so keep defensive spells ready.

Braum.summary: His shield eats your poke and his passive punishes long trades. Keep Q and R for disengaging rather than trading.

Janna.summary: Her disengage makes it hard to force fights. Play for scaling and do not waste Q into her peel.

Lulu.summary: Both supports protect well. Skip long poke battles and get value from buffing your carry instead.

Taric.summary: Strong in melee range, but his engage is predictable. Keep distance and play around his cooldowns.

Nami.summary: She pokes and heals well but is vulnerable to your Q. Punish her when her E and W are on cooldown.

Maokai.summary: His engage is predictable and you can interrupt his W, but his chained CC is still dangerous if it lands.

Poppy.summary: She can punish bad positioning and block your movement. Keep your distance and she is much less threatening.

Zilean.summary: His speed and slow control plus his ultimate make fights awkward, but you can still protect your team well.

Velkoz.summary: He has long-range poke but becomes vulnerable if he misses his E. Your healing can absorb some of his pressure.

Nautilus.summary: His engage is predictable, but one misstep can decide the lane. Stay behind minions, keep Q for his follow-up, and do not give him free openings.

Morgana.summary: Her Black Shield blocks your Q and her root punishes bad positioning. From level 6, your ultimate can fully negate her Q and R engage.

Alistar.summary: He threatens your ADC with engage, but his range is easy to read. Q him as he comes in or disengage after his combo.

Soraka.summary: She sustains well but is vulnerable to poke and pressure. Look for Q hits and punish her positioning.

Renata.summary: Her W and ultimate can swing fights, but she lacks steady pressure on you. Save your ultimate for her CC.

Lux.summary: Her Q is the danger; once it misses, she has little else to threaten you with. Play around her cooldowns.

Seraphine.summary: She brings lots of teamfight utility, but you usually have enough tools to protect your ADC and cleanse her CC.

Yuumi.summary: She puts little pressure on you directly, so the lane mostly comes down to how well her ADC plays.

Sona.summary: Mostly a scaling matchup. Pressure her early and do not give her free poke.

Xerath.summary: Strong range and poke, but he is exposed when his E stun is on cooldown.

Karma.summary: Strong early poke, but your utility outscales hers in longer games. Avoid needless early trades.

Zyra.summary: She pokes well but is vulnerable if her E misses. Use Q to interrupt her engage.

Pantheon.summary: His early all-in is dangerous, but once you survive the first pressure your range and defensive tools make him manageable.

Bard.summary: He pressures through roaming, but you can protect your ADC comfortably. Keep track of where he goes.

TahmKench.summary: Hard to kill but has little reliable access to you. Play around his W and keep Q for his engage.
